response.justification: Bogdan brings 20 years of software engineering experience and entrepreneurial capability through GISCollective, meeting the basic experience requirements. However, the role demands deep AI strategic expertise and demonstrated AI product platforms—his AI exposure appears limited to the past 1.5 years in an infrastructure/tooling capacity rather than strategic product development or customer advisory. Additionally, his current Staff Engineer title and background lack the director-level positioning and strategic leadership experience the role requires.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering across diverse technical domains (web, mobile, embedded, infrastructure) with strong technical fundamentals
Founder of GISCollective and multiple open-source projects demonstrating entrepreneurial drive and ability to build technical initiatives from scratch
Current role involves AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, showing exposure to modern AI tooling and agentic workflows
concerns: AI expertise is very recent (~1.5 years) and narrowly focused on infrastructure/tooling rather than strategic AI product development or platform architecture required for the role

No director-level strategic leadership experience; current Staff Engineer title and background show individual contributor focus, not director-level positioning for strategic advice and customer advisory
Lacks Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field, and no demonstrated AI products or platforms shipped with AI technology, falling short of 'recognized expertise' requirement

key_factors.factor: Lack of Director-Level and Customer Advisory Experience
